technical_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and form submissions MUST include distinct role-based kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-quote-button', data-testid='enquiry-submit-btn', data-testid='warehouse-hub-bhiwandi-card')
technical_requirements.header_nav: Sticky header with glassmorphism, brand horizontal logo asset, active page underline, contact phone badge, and 'Get RFQ Quote' CTA button

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow dark industrial luxury aesthetics (#0B0C0E background, #FF5722 orange brand triggers).
Never use generic centered layouts or plain white backgrounds.
Ensure generous spacing (p-8 to p-16) and distinct high contrast text.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
Use logo assets provided in brand_assets.
Include quote submission form connected to FastAPI backend with toast notifications via sonner.
